content: Cognitive capacity is a critical factor in the effective management of diabetes. It enables individuals to make well-informed decisions regarding their self-care and facilitates collaboration with healthcare providers. In cases where cognitive decline is identified, integrating a lay care professional into the diabetes care team can be advantageous. This individual can assist with daily monitoring of the patient’s condition and act as a liaison between the patient and the broader care team. For youth with diabetes, support from parents or adult caregivers may be necessary until they reach a developmental stage where they can fully comprehend and act upon essential information related to diabetes management.
